description: This file defines the 'Schedulers' system for managing scheduled jobs within the Mattermost server, including starting, stopping, scheduling, and handling configuration and cluster leadership changes.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Interface for individual job schedulers with methods to check if enabled, determine next schedule time, and schedule jobs.

classes.name: Schedulers
classes.description: Main class managing multiple job schedulers, their lifecycle, and execution logic.

methods.name: AddScheduler
methods.description: Adds a new scheduler to the collection.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the scheduler loop, initializing timers and handling scheduling logic.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler loop and cleans up resources.

methods.name: setNextRunTime
methods.description: Calculates and sets the next run time for a specific scheduler.

methods.name: scheduleJob
methods.description: Schedules a job using the specified scheduler.

methods.name: handleClusterLeaderChange
methods.description: Handles changes in cluster leadership status.
